name: omentir-marketing-copy
description: Enforces human, non-AI writing for all Omentir user-facing text. Applies the humanizer workflow before writing or editing marketing copy, SEO pages, blogs, guides, comparisons, features, alternatives, use cases, integrations, homepage text, meta descriptions, titles, FAQs, hero copy, CTAs, and any string shown on omentir.com. Use automatically whenever creating, drafting, revising, or reviewing visible site content in this repository.
